title: Man meets grandmother during panic attack near-death
content:
Seven years ago, I was experiencing stress and anxiety at work, coupled with the effects of having to go into full time work instead of being able to participate in a schedule of voluntary work which I had done for the past 2 years. I was lying in bed when I felt short of breath and started to hyperventilate. I felt my heart and breathing stop and lost consciousness.

It felt that I was falling through different levels of consciousness which you encounter during sleep, with an intense feeling of love and calmness descending on me, the more I fell through each level of consciousness. This feeling of love, calmness and serenity continued to grow in intensity until I reached a place where my paternal grandmother was sitting at a table in the dining room at my parents’ house surrounded by a beautiful orange, purple and red light whilst a calming, otherworldly white noise sound was emanating from all around. We did not talk, but telepathically communicated to each other a feeling of unconditional love, mixed with a feeling of "not to worry." She appeared to be grinning, as if at peace and very happy.

At this point I felt my heart and breath restart, and I regained consciousness.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Felt like falling through different levels of consciousness encountered during sleep.

environment.environment_other_detail: Calming, otherworldly white noise sound emanating from all around; dining room at parents’ house with grandmother at a table surrounded by orange, purple and red light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Panic attack/hyperventilation with perceived heart and breathing stopping while in bed.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transitional phase described as falling through levels of consciousness; telepathic exchange of unconditional love and reassurance ('not to worry'); return coincided with heart and breath restarting.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Falling through levels of consciousness -> arrival in familiar dining room setting with grandmother and colored light/white noise -> heart/breath restarted and regained consciousness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience framed as falling through sleep-like levels of consciousness; setting was the dining room at parents’ house with grandmother present and surrounded by orange/purple/red light; 'otherworldly white noise' sound.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "falling through different levels of consciousness"; "an intense feeling of love and calmness"; "surrounded by a beautiful orange, purple and red light"; "a calming, otherworldly white noise sound"; "telepathically communicated... a feeling of unconditional love, mixed with a feeling of 'not to worry.'"
